title: GMI technology economic-change evidence envelope v1 (technology_economic_change.evidence.v1)
description: Closed evidence envelope for the Technology ex-Semis company-first research profile (T8A, macro#7891; proposed §8 shape @ 382c0b399d5c on #7870, under Sol adjudication). Exactly ONE authorized, already-accepted shared curation assertion, deep-copied verbatim from the owner bundle; its internal shape is owned by theme_graph.curation_assertion.v1 (macro#7870) and is deliberately the only open object here. The generation is the dossier_id of the composed dossier that actually rendered the citing row/card/counter, so the envelope can never cite a projection it was not selected from. Unknown and not-selected references share one refusal code, so the envelope discloses no existence. Authority ceiling research_display_only: all six flags literally false (ECD-48); this envelope ranks, gates, sizes, vetoes, originates and opens nothing.

generation.description: The dossier_id grammar of technology_economic_change.v1: the composed dossier that rendered the citing row/card/counter.

assertion.description: Deep copy of the one authorized assertion, verbatim. Open on purpose: the shared assertion contract (theme_graph.curation_assertion.v1) owns this shape; restating it here would fork the shared contract.

limitations.description: Sorted dossier-level limitation texts relevant to the cited content; may be empty when the composed dossier carries none.
